name: Roman Theater (Calama)
description: One of the most beautiful and well-preserved Roman theaters in North Africa, built during the 2nd century AD. It marks the ancient heritage of Calama.

name: Hammam Debagh (Meskhoutine)
description: Famous for its natural limestone waterfall and thermal waters that reach boiling temperatures. Known as one of the hottest springs in the world.

name: Bouhamdane Dam
description: A stunning reservoir surrounded by mountains, perfect for hiking, picnics, and observing local wildlife. A vital water source for the region.

name: Guelma Archeological Museum
description: Located near the Roman theater, it houses a rich collection of statues, mosaics, and everyday objects from the Numidian and Roman eras.

name: Ain Ben Beida Forest
description: A lush forest area ideal for nature enthusiasts and mountain biking, offering fresh air and diverse Mediterranean flora.

name: El Hamma Roman Pool
description: An ancient thermal bath site where Roman structures are still partially used today by locals, blending history with daily life.
